title: Create a Greentic Flow
summary: Create a Greentic flow by defining typed steps, input/output mappings, and replayable validations.

modules.title: Define the Flow Contract
modules.objective: Use the flow schema and answers file to define steps and data movement explicitly.

steps.instruction: Capture the flow schema before writing step files.
Create a reviewed flow answers file with step IDs, component bindings, and mapping rules.

modules.title: Apply and Replay
modules.objective: Generate the flow and prove it can replay with fixture inputs.

steps.instruction: Apply the flow answers through the wizard.
steps.expected_output: Flow files and step mapping config are generated.

steps.instruction: Replay the flow with fixture input.
steps.expected_output: Replay completes and writes expected outputs.

deprecated_commands.command: hand-wire flow steps without mapping validation
deprecated_commands.reason: Flow mappings must be explicit and replayable.
